# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 R2 Latin Greece phases 1-4, the Navarrese and the Acciaioli 1379-1396, the West changes hands 1347-1375, the Ottomans and the Tocco 1385-1449, the late years 1383-1446 (oe_lgr_). Generated by gen_latin_greece.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 3.2, as W5's oe_emd_calm): no civil war, no theme revolt, no
# Byzantine intrigue. World steps do not wait for it.

    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    oe_bi_active = no
}

# Country scope. "The lord of Athens" (design 3.2): ATH, or ARG once vanilla flavor_ath has made it Athens.
oe_lgr_ath_lord = { oe_lgr_latin = yes OR = { tag = ATH AND = { tag = ARG has_variable = de_brienne_rule_of_athens } } }
# Any scope. Athens has such a lord.
oe_lgr_has_ath = { location:athens = { exists = owner owner = { oe_lgr_ath_lord = yes } } }
# Any scope. Nerio I (the character la3 made, marked oe_lgr_is_nerio) rules ATH. The stored character (global
# oe_lgr_nerio) is not read here: a dead character behind a variable is untested.
oe_lgr_nerio_rules = { country_exists = c:ATH c:ATH = { exists = ruler ruler = { has_variable = oe_lgr_is_nerio } } }
# Location scope. Imperial land lies next to it, or next to one of its neighbours. (Corinth's land neighbours are
# Argos, Nauplia, Damala, Xylokastro and Megara; in 1337 the empire holds none of them, but Astros and Tripolitsa
# border Argos.)
oe_lgr_near_empire = { any_neighbor_location = { OR = { owner ?= c:BYZ any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } }
# Any scope. la3's third part: Corinth can go from Achaea to Athens (both AI, not at war with each other, the city
# neither occupied nor under siege).
oe_lgr_cor_movable = {
    country_exists = c:ACH country_exists = c:ATH
    c:ACH = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:ATH } }
    c:ATH = { is_ai = yes }
    location:corinth = { owner ?= c:ACH controller ?= c:ACH has_siege = no }
}

oe_lgr_ep3_skip = { OR = { location:arta = { exists = owner owner = { is_ai = no } } AND = { is_ai = no oe_lgr_nik_home = yes } } }
oe_lgr_ep4_skip = { AND = { country_exists = c:EPI c:EPI = { is_ai = no } } }
oe_lgr_ep5_skip = { location:ioannina = { exists = owner owner = { is_ai = no } } }
oe_lgr_ep6_skip = { AND = { country_exists = c:THS c:THS = { is_ai = no } } }
oe_lgr_ep7_skip = { AND = { country_exists = c:EPI c:EPI = { is_ai = no } } }
oe_lgr_ep8_skip = { oe_lgr_ioa_alive = yes global_var:oe_lgr_ioa = { is_ai = no } }
oe_lgr_ep9_skip = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:THS c:THS = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:TUR country_exists = c:THS c:TUR = { is_at_war_with = c:THS } } AND = { country_exists = c:THS c:THS = { OR = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = no } } } } } }
oe_lgr_ep10_skip = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:SAO c:SAO = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:TUR country_exists = c:SAO c:TUR = { is_at_war_with = c:SAO } } } }
oe_lgr_ep11_skip = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:CEP c:CEP = { is_ai = no } } AND = { oe_lgr_ioa_alive = yes global_var:oe_lgr_ioa = { OR = { is_ai = no overlord ?= { is_ai = no } } } } } }
oe_lgr_ep12_skip = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:CEP c:CEP = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:EPI c:EPI = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:EPI c:EPI = { OR = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes overlord ?= { is_ai = no } } } } } }
oe_lgr_ep13_skip = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = no } } location:ioannina = { oe_lgr_ott_held_off = yes } } }
oe_lgr_ep14_skip = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = no } } location:arta = { oe_lgr_ott_held_off = yes } } }
oe_lgr_la5_skip = { AND = { country_exists = c:NAX c:NAX = { is_ai = no } } }
oe_lgr_la6_skip = { OR = { AND = { country_exists = c:NEG c:NEG = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { is_ai = no } } AND = { country_exists = c:VEN country_exists = c:NEG c:VEN = { is_at_war_with = c:NEG } } } }
oe_lgr_la7_skip = { AND = { country_exists = c:ACH c:ACH = { is_ai = no } } }
oe_lgr_la8_skip = { AND = { country_exists = c:ACH c:ACH = { is_ai = no } } }

# BYZ scope. Each event's own trigger (also checked when a test button fires it).
oe_lgr_ev_1 = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_navarrese country_exists = c:ACH }
oe_lgr_ev_2 = { oe_lgr_nerio_rules = yes location:athens = { owner ?= c:ATH } c:ATH = { oe_lgr_latin = yes } }
oe_lgr_ev_3 = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_will location:corinth = { oe_mo_latin_held = yes } }
oe_lgr_ev_4 = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_navarrese global_var:oe_lgr_navarrese = 1 country_exists = c:ACH c:ACH = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } }
oe_lgr_ev_11 = { oe_lgr_nik_home = yes oe_lgr_arta_foreign = yes NOT = { country_exists = c:EPI } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep3 } }
oe_lgr_ev_12 = { country_exists = c:THS c:THS = { is_ai = yes is_subject = no exists = ruler NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ths global_var:oe_lgr_ths = 2 }
oe_lgr_ev_13 = { country_exists = c:SAO c:SAO = { is_ai = yes } location:salona = { owner ?= c:SAO } }
oe_lgr_ev_14 = { location:ioannina = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
oe_lgr_ev_20 = { oe_lgr_has_ath = yes }
# BYZ scope. The monthly check may roll this event: its world step ran, the months since, its trigger.
oe_lgr_ok_1 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_1 } oe_lgr_ran_la2 = yes has_variable = oe_lgr_nav_m oe_lgr_since_nav >= 1 oe_lgr_since_nav <= 42 oe_lgr_ev_1 = yes oe_lgr_morea_ok = yes c:ACH = { religion = religion:catholic NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } is_neighbor_of_country_or_across_one_seazone = c:BYZ } }
oe_lgr_ok_2 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_2 } oe_lgr_ran_la3 = yes has_variable = oe_lgr_ath_m oe_lgr_since_ath >= 1 oe_lgr_since_ath <= 36 oe_lgr_ev_2 = yes oe_lgr_morea_ok = yes OR = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_1 oe_lgr_ran_la2 = no oe_lgr_since_ath >= 30 } }
oe_lgr_ok_3 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_3 } oe_lgr_ran_la4 = yes has_variable = oe_lgr_will_m oe_lgr_since_will >= 1 oe_lgr_since_will <= 18 oe_lgr_ev_3 = yes oe_lgr_morea_ok = yes location:corinth = { owner = { is_ai = yes } oe_lgr_near_empire = yes } }
oe_lgr_ok_14 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_14 } oe_lgr_ran_ep13 = yes has_variable = oe_lgr_ioa_m oe_lgr_since_ioa >= 1 oe_lgr_since_ioa <= 18 oe_lgr_ev_14 = yes country_exists = c:TUR }
# BYZ scope. The event can no longer come: its world step was missed, or the grace has passed.
oe_lgr_lapse_1 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_1 } OR = { oe_lgr_missed_la2 = yes AND = { has_variable = oe_lgr_nav_m oe_lgr_since_nav > 42 } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_2 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_2 } OR = { oe_lgr_missed_la3 = yes AND = { has_variable = oe_lgr_ath_m oe_lgr_since_ath > 36 } AND = { oe_lgr_ran_la3 = yes oe_lgr_nerio_rules = no } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_3 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_3 } OR = { oe_lgr_missed_la4 = yes AND = { has_variable = oe_lgr_will_m oe_lgr_since_will > 18 } location:corinth = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_14 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_14 } OR = { oe_lgr_missed_ep13 = yes AND = { has_variable = oe_lgr_ioa_m oe_lgr_since_ioa > 18 } NOT = { location:ioannina = { owner ?= c:TUR } } } }
# BYZ scope. Phase 2: events with a window of their own (months of the shared lock; sure in the last, then grace).
oe_lgr_ok_4 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_4 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m var:oe_lgr_m >= 699 var:oe_lgr_m <= 720 oe_lgr_ev_4 = yes oe_lgr_morea_ok = yes c:ACH = { is_neighbor_of_country_or_across_one_seazone = c:BYZ } }
oe_lgr_ok_11 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_11 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m var:oe_lgr_m >= 229 var:oe_lgr_m <= 258 oe_lgr_ev_11 = yes has_variable = oe_br_done_3 }
oe_lgr_ok_12 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_12 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m var:oe_lgr_m >= 541 var:oe_lgr_m <= 642 oe_lgr_ev_12 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } OR = { var:oe_ths_stage_a ?= 1 var:oe_ths_stage_a ?= 2 location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } }
oe_lgr_ok_13 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_13 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m var:oe_lgr_m >= 661 var:oe_lgr_m <= 696 oe_lgr_ev_13 = yes oe_lgr_ott_ok = yes country_exists = c:TUR country_exists = c:SAO NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep10 } OR = { oe_lgr_ran_ep9 = yes c:SAO = { is_neighbor_of = c:TUR } } }
oe_lgr_ok_20 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_20 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m var:oe_lgr_m >= 1290 var:oe_lgr_m <= 1314 oe_lgr_ev_20 = yes oe_lgr_morea_ok = yes OR = { location:corinth = { owner ?= c:BYZ } has_global_variable = oe_mo_despotate } location:athens = { owner = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } NOT = { overlord ?= { tag = BYZ } } } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_4 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_4 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m OR = { var:oe_lgr_m > 720 AND = { var:oe_lgr_m >= 699 OR = { oe_lgr_missed_la2 = yes NOT = { country_exists = c:ACH } } } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_11 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_11 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m OR = { var:oe_lgr_m > 258 AND = { var:oe_lgr_m >= 229 OR = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep3 oe_lgr_nik_home = no } } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_12 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_12 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m OR = { var:oe_lgr_m > 642 AND = { var:oe_lgr_m >= 541 OR = { oe_lgr_missed_ep6 = yes NOT = { country_exists = c:THS } } } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_13 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_13 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m OR = { var:oe_lgr_m > 696 AND = { var:oe_lgr_m >= 661 OR = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ws_ep10 NOT = { location:salona = { owner ?= c:SAO } } } } } }
oe_lgr_lapse_20 = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_20 } has_variable = oe_lgr_m OR = { var:oe_lgr_m > 1314 AND = { var:oe_lgr_m >= 1290 OR = { oe_lgr_has_ath = no } } } }

# BYZ scope. The chronicle (gen_chronicle.py line lgr1, a hook in plan_20261117/v66/r2-lgr1_实施.md). Phase 1 is over
# once its three events have come or lapsed (by 1398 at the latest). Void: nothing of it happened (neither the
# Company in Achaea nor the Acciaioli in Athens) and it is over, or Achaea is gone and Athens is in no Latin hands.
# Under way: from the first world step that ran.
oe_lgr_p1_none = { oe_lgr_ran_la2 = no oe_lgr_ran_la3 = no }
oe_lgr_p1_over = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_1 has_variable = oe_lgr_st_2 has_variable = oe_lgr_st_3 }
oe_lgr_chr_void = {
    oe_lgr_p1_none = yes
    OR = {
        oe_lgr_p1_over = yes
        AND = {
            NOT = { country_exists = c:ACH }
            NOT = { location:athens = { exists = owner owner = { religion = religion:catholic } } }
        }
    }
}
# Phase 4 (r2-lgr4) extends this row to 1446: it is over once .4 and .20 have come or lapsed (from 1447 at the latest).
oe_lgr_p4_over = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_4 has_variable = oe_lgr_st_20 } current_date >= 1447.1.1 } }
oe_lgr_chr_done = { oe_lgr_p1_over = yes oe_lgr_p4_over = yes }
oe_lgr_chr_run = { OR = { oe_lgr_ran_la1 = yes oe_lgr_ran_la2 = yes oe_lgr_ran_la3 = yes } }
# BYZ scope. The chronicle's second row "Epirus and Thessaly 1356-1430" (hook in plan_20261117/v66/r2-lgr2_实施.md,
# extended by phase 3: plan_20261117/v66/r2-lgr3_实施.md). Under way once Thessaly's emperor (ep2) or Nikephoros's
# return (ep3) has come; over once Ioannina has opened its gates to the sultan (ep13 ran) or from 1431; void when
# neither came and both windows have passed (the empire kept the West, or Serbia never held it).
oe_lgr_chr2_run = { OR = { oe_lgr_ran_ep2 = yes oe_lgr_ran_ep3 = yes } }
oe_lgr_chr2_done = { oe_lgr_chr2_run = yes OR = { oe_lgr_ran_ep13 = yes current_date >= 1431.1.1 } }
oe_lgr_chr2_void = { oe_lgr_chr2_run = no oe_lgr_missed_ep2 = yes oe_lgr_missed_ep3 = yes }

# ---- phase 3 (the Ottomans and the Tocco, 1385-1449)
# Any scope. Ioannina, the dynamic country ep5 built (global oe_lgr_ioa, marked oe_lgr_ioannina), still exists. Phase 3
# reads it only so, never by a tag.
oe_lgr_ioa_alive = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ioa country_exists = global_var:oe_lgr_ioa global_var:oe_lgr_ioa = { has_variable = oe_lgr_ioannina } }
# BYZ scope. ep10 waits for .13 while .13 can still come in its own window (to month 690).
oe_lgr_ep10_wait = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_lgr_st_13 } var:oe_lgr_m <= 690 }
# Location scope. Its owner keeps the Ottomans off: a human, a member of the imperial bloc, or at war with them (the
# skip of ep13, ep14).
oe_lgr_ott_held_off = { exists = owner owner = { OR = { is_ai = no oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes AND = { country_exists = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } }
# Any scope. ep13 / ep14: X is held, in hand and not besieged, by an AI that is neither the Ottomans nor the empire,
# outside the imperial bloc, bordering the Ottomans and at peace with them; and X is not that owner's capital unless
# every place the owner has is among those the step moves (brief: never the capital of a country that has other land).
oe_lgr_ott_take_ioannina = { country_exists = c:TUR location:ioannina = { exists = owner owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = TUR } NOT = { tag = BYZ } NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } is_neighbor_of = c:TUR NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } controller ?= location:ioannina.owner has_siege = no OR = { is_capital = no owner = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { NOT = { OR = { this = location:ioannina this = location:avlonya this = location:argyrokastro this = location:butrint this = location:kleisoura_epirus this = location:konitsa } } } } } } } }
oe_lgr_ott_take_arta = { country_exists = c:TUR location:arta = { exists = owner owner = { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = TUR } NOT = { tag = BYZ } NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } is_neighbor_of = c:TUR NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } controller ?= location:arta.owner has_siege = no OR = { is_capital = no owner = { NOT = { any_owned_location = { NOT = { OR = { this = location:arta this = location:preveza } } } } } } } }
# Any scope. The result a step that takes a country or moves land looks for (oe_lgr_check_<s>).
oe_lgr_done_ep9 = { NOT = { country_exists = c:THS } }
oe_lgr_done_ep10 = { location:salona = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
oe_lgr_done_ep11 = { location:ioannina = { owner ?= c:CEP } }
oe_lgr_done_ep12 = { location:arta = { owner ?= c:CEP } }
oe_lgr_done_ep13 = { location:ioannina = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
oe_lgr_done_ep14 = { location:arta = { owner ?= c:TUR } }

# ---- phase 4 (the late years of Latin Greece, 1383-1446)
# Location scope. .4 b: a place of Achaea the empire can take for the captain: Achaea owns and holds it, no siege, not
# its capital, and it borders a place of the empire.
oe_lgr_ach_swap = { owner ?= c:ACH controller ?= c:ACH has_siege = no is_capital = no any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
# Any scope. The result phase 4 looks for after it makes a subject (oe_lgr_check_<s>).
oe_lgr_done_la6 = { country_exists = c:NEG c:NEG = { overlord ?= { tag = VEN } } }
oe_lgr_done_ath20 = { has_global_variable = oe_lgr_ath_client_c country_exists = global_var:oe_lgr_ath_client_c global_var:oe_lgr_ath_client_c = { overlord ?= { tag = BYZ } } }
